essence: Because past, future, and present all dissolve in consciousness, time is fully manifested by the lord of consciousness alone.
For consciousness whose nature manifests time, transmigration is the play of being and nonbeing appearing within its own form.
The unfolding of knowerhood is the dynamic abiding in one's own form through affirmations and negations of 'I', 'this', and 'that'.
The varied play of nonbeing belongs to manifestation, but pure knowerhood itself does not contain separate abiding of those distinctions.
Pure isolated knowerhood cannot account for cognition, whereas all worldly knowerhood is constituted by such differentiated cognition.
